articles.title: Boeing to cut 5% of commercial airplane workforce as production increase is slower than expected
articles.description: Boeing said Monday that it plans to cut 5% of its commercial airplane workforce as its production ramp-up is moving at a slower pace than the company expected.

articles.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
articles.description: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

articles.title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC
articles.description: Operating under the SEC’s “Innovation Exemption,” the firm plans to list tokenized shares of Exodus, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital in early 2027, with the same voting and dividend rights as real stock.

articles.title: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
articles.description: Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.

articles.title: We're adding a consumer stock to diversify beyond the volatile AI trade
articles.description: We wanted to add a less cyclical company with a cheap valuation and that consistently returns capital to its shareholders.

articles.title: Trump questions midterm election results, revives voting-machine conspiracy
articles.description: President Trump's questioning of the legitimacy of his loss in the 2020 election culminated with an attack on the U.S. Capitol by a mob of his supporters.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin Moves On From ‘Ultrasound Money,’ Says ETH’s Value Is Stability
articles.description: The Ethereum co-founder says ETH's value comes from stability, not fee burns, citing its decentralization, censorship resistance and security.

articles.title: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target
articles.description: Bitcoin rebounded from an 11-week low near $73,500 as the Nasdaq Composite rallied despite sell-off in Nvidia shares.

articles.title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $20M in Ethereum, Seizing on Vitalik’s 'ETH Is Money' Declaration
articles.description: The firm’s stash reached 6.07 million ETH—4.97% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee called Vitalik Buterin’s “ETH is money” comments a “seismic shift.”

articles.title: Nvidia's CEO turmoil gives newly empowered Democrats fresh ammunition in pursuit of oversight
articles.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy comes as the company is already about to face heightened scrutiny.

articles.title: Honda to invest $3 billion in new vehicle assembly plant in Ohio
articles.description: The Japanese automaker said the plant will focus on hybrid vehicles and is expected to begin production in 2029.

articles.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
articles.description: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

articles.title: NYSE Taps Avalanche to Settle Its Planned Tokenized Stock Platform
articles.description: Ava Labs said Avalanche will serve as the “core ledger technology” for the clearing firm behind the NYSE-affiliated venue, which aims to bring 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement of tokenized securities onchain.

articles.title: Weekend trading of Nvidia scandal shines light on new financial products
articles.description: Nvidia scandal shines light growing use of perpetual futures and other trading products

articles.title: Google’s AI chip push adds more pressure on Nvidia
articles.description: Google’s specialised AI chips threaten greater competition as Nvidia faces a leadership investigation.

articles.title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack
articles.description: North Korean hackers used six homemade memecoins to launder 117,000 NEAR, worth about $430,000, from the $6.3 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says.

articles.title: Goodyear Tire CEO Mark Stewart steps down as company continues turnaround plan
articles.description: Goodyear Tire & Rubber appointed board member Roger Wood interim CEO and president, replacing Mark Stewart as the tire maker continues its turnaround plan.

articles.title: Eli Lilly’s Foundayo obesity pill eases sleep apnea in late-stage trial, paving way for approval
articles.description: Lilly plans to file by the end of the year for U.S. approval of the daily pill for moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea in adults with obesity.

articles.title: Amazon's Astro home robot has fans but looks destined for the 'trash heap.' Why it's trying again
articles.description: Amazon has formed a new home robotics team and is hiring for a “new-to-world robot product,” according to CNBC’s analysis of job posts.

articles.title: Why tech workers are flocking to NYC
articles.description: New York City now has more tech employees than the Bay Area. Here's why workers — and companies — are flocking to the city.
